headline: Approved $176.27 rent increase for 132 Marginal Way, elected Kristen Carreras Vice Chair, tabled 1303 Forest Ave application.
summary: The board approved the June 24, 2026 minutes and a $176.27 rent increase for 132 Marginal Way. It found rent increase applications for 56 Federal St and 24 Rowe Ave complete, and tabled the application for 1303 Forest Ave until conditions are met. Kristen Carreras was elected Vice Chair.
decisions: Approved the June 24, 2026 minutes as written, 5-0, with Christopher "Buddy" Moore absent.
Approved a rent increase of $176.27 for 132 Marginal Way, for 196 units, 5-0.
Found the rent increase application for 56 Federal Street complete and scheduled it for a public hearing, 6-0.
Tabled the rent increase application for 1303 Forest Avenue, Units A and B, until completeness conditions are met, 6-0.
Found the rent increase application for 24 Rowe Ave complete, pending requested items, 6-0.
Elected Kristen Carreras as Vice Chair.

decision_evidence.quote: Kristen Carreras moves to approve June 24, 2026 Minutes as written. Seconded by Anne-Laure Razat. (5-0; Christopher "Buddy" Moore absent) The motion passes.
Anne-Laure Razat moves to approve a rent increase of $176.27 for 132 Marginal Way, for 196 units. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (5-0; Christopher "Buddy" Moore absent) The motion passes.
Anne-Laure Razat moves to find the application for 56 Federal Street complete and schedule for a public hearing. Seconded by Kristen Carreras. (6-0) The motion passes.
James "Gordon" Platt moves to table the application for 1303 Forest Avenue, Units A and B, until the list of completeness conditions have been met. Seconded by Matthew Lax. (6-0) The motion passes.
Kristen Carreras moves to find application for 24 Rowe Ave complete pending items requested. Seconded by Jonas Burke. (6-0) The motion passes.
Kristen Carreras is elected to Vice Chair.
